image_description: A large parabolic dish antenna of a radio telescope, viewed from below looking up into the dish. The dish is constructed with a metal mesh surface supported by a complex truss framework of steel beams radiating from the center. The sky is visible through the mesh. The central feed horn structure is partially visible at the bottom of the frame.
